summary_oneline: Replace the single QSourceTool with a tenant-scoped QuerysourceToolkit that lists/describes/executes query-slugs and lists/validates/runs/saves MultiQuery pipelines, with a generated conditions-dialect reference for the LLM.

localization.role: Current single tool to be replaced (hard cut); vague `conditions` schema, latent DataNotFound NameError.
Existing AbstractToolkit base over querysource with a `program` attribute; precedent for the tenant name, not a base to subclass.
Sibling QS consumer: permanent_filter precedence and patchable lazy QS import to mirror.
Execution contract: QS(slug|query+driver|raw_query, conditions, lazy, dwh); build_provider(); query(output_format) -> (result, error); dry_run(); close().
Slug resolution by PK only; the `program` argument is ignored, so tenancy is not enforced by the library.
public.queries row: query_slug PK, conditions/cond_definition/filtering/fields/ordering/grouping, query_raw, provider, program_slug.
Source of the conditions dialect (option keys, placeholder vs WHERE routing, @variables); wheel ships only compiled parsers.
WHERE value grammar (scalar, !, list/IN, [op,v], {op:v}, BETWEEN, null/!null, bool).
Pipeline executor; a persisted multi-query is a queries row whose query_raw is the pipeline JSON.
In-process get_catalog() (same payload as /api/v3/qs/components) and validate_pipeline().
Reference for slug list/get/upsert semantics (default_fields, QueryModel.get/insert/update) the toolkit reproduces in-process.
Toolkit base: tool_prefix, exclude_tools, auto_open, _prepare_kwargs/_pre_execute/_post_execute hooks.
Reference toolkit shape to mirror (prefix, exclusions, Pydantic result dump).
Auto-generated registry holding the only references to QSourceTool (q_source, qsource); regenerate after the rename.
Existing tenant primitive (tenant_id) if per-call tenant derivation is wanted.

constraints.statement: QS() and QueryConnection.get_slug() resolve a slug by primary key and ignore `program`; nothing in the library or in ai-parrot filters by program_slug.
constraints.implication: The toolkit must load the QueryModel row itself and check program_slug against its allowlist BEFORE calling QS/MultiQS, for every slug referenced (including every `queries[*].slug` inside a pipeline).

constraints.statement: The conditions dialect lives in compiled Cython/Rust parsers; the readable source is only on GitHub (dev/main) and may drift from the pinned wheel (4.5.11).
constraints.implication: Ship the dialect reference as a versioned, static artefact in the toolkit (generated from F007 and re-verified at spec time), plus a `dry_run` probe so the LLM can see the rendered query; do not try to introspect the parser at runtime.

constraints.statement: A caller's `conditions` dict is a mixed bag: reserved option keys (fields, querylimit/_limit, _offset, ordering, grouping, filter/where_cond, refresh, ...) are popped, keys present in cond_definition become placeholders, everything else becomes WHERE filters; a nested `conditions` key is also merged.
constraints.implication: Expose the tool arguments as typed, separate fields (placeholders, filter, fields, ordering, grouping, limit, offset, refresh) and assemble the QS payload deterministically instead of a free-form `conditions` blob.

constraints.statement: ComponentRegistry.get_catalog() is synchronous and does module discovery/introspection; the REST handler runs it in asyncio.to_thread.
constraints.implication: Call it via asyncio.to_thread and cache the catalog per toolkit instance; the toolkit does not need HTTP access to /api/v3/qs/components.

constraints.statement: A persisted MultiQuery is an ordinary public.queries row whose query_raw holds the pipeline JSON (detected by the presence of queries/files/sources); there is no provider flag.
constraints.implication: describe_slug must detect and label multi-query slugs; save_multiquery (if allowed) writes a QueryModel row with query_raw=json and program_slug forced to the tenant.

constraints.statement: TOOL_REGISTRY in parrot_tools/__init__.py is auto-generated and holds the only references to QSourceTool.
constraints.implication: Deleting qsource.py is a safe hard cut; regenerate the registry with scripts/generate_tool_registry.py rather than hand-editing.

constraints.statement: Toolkits expose public async methods as tools, with tool_prefix/exclude_tools/_prepare_kwargs/_pre_execute/auto_open available; DatabaseQueryToolkit is the current reference shape.
constraints.implication: Implement QuerysourceToolkit(AbstractToolkit) with tool_prefix='qs', enforce tenancy in _pre_execute/_prepare_kwargs, keep querysource imports lazy and patchable as query_slug.py does.

constraints.statement: There are no tests for qsource.py or querytoolkit.py; QuerySlugSource tests mock the lazy QS import.
constraints.implication: The refactor must add packages/ai-parrot-tools/tests/querysource/ with fakes for QS, MultiQS, QueryModel and ComponentRegistry; no live DB in unit tests.

recent_history.author: Jesus
recent_history.message: feat(runtime-dependency-reduction): TASK-389 — Database/Query Tools Lazy Imports

whats_new: packages/ai-parrot-tools/src/parrot_tools/querysource/ package: QuerysourceToolkit(AbstractToolkit) with tool_prefix 'qs' and tools: qs_get_dialect_reference, qs_list_slugs, qs_describe_slug (incl. optional dry_run), qs_execute_slug, qs_list_components, qs_validate_pipeline, qs_run_multiquery, qs_save_multiquery (write, confirming, opt-in).

Pydantic models for tool inputs/outputs (SlugSummary, SlugDetail, ExecutionResult with bounded rows + row_count/columns, PipelineValidation, ComponentInfo mirror) and a static, versioned dialect reference (option keys, placeholder vs WHERE routing, WHERE value grammar, @variables note).
Tenant scoping: constructor `programs` allowlist (None = unrestricted) enforced on list/describe/execute/run/save and on every slug referenced by a pipeline; raw SQL nodes gated by a separate flag.
Unit tests under packages/ai-parrot-tools/tests/querysource/ with fakes for QS, MultiQS, QueryModel and ComponentRegistry.

what_changes.change: Deleted (hard cut); behaviour absorbed by qs_execute_slug.
Regenerated: drop q_source/qsource, add querysource toolkit entry.
querysource stays an optional extra; document the minimum version the dialect reference was verified against.

non_goals: Modifying the querysource library (adding program filtering to get_slug, exposing parser sources).
Replacing QuerySlugSource/MultiQuerySlugSource in dataset_manager or QueryToolkit subclasses (PricesTool, EpsonProductToolkit).
Calling the QuerySource REST API from the toolkit (everything is in-process via the installed package).
PBAC/Guardian integration — tenancy here is a program_slug allowlist, not policy evaluation.

patterns_to_follow.pattern: DatabaseQueryToolkit shape: tool_prefix, exclude_tools, docstring listing tool names, _post_execute model_dump.
Lazy, patchable querysource import (module-level QS = None + _get_qs()).
permanent_filter precedence: toolkit-level forced conditions override LLM-supplied ones.

integration_risks.risk: Dialect reference drifts from the installed querysource version.
integration_risks.mitigation: Pin the version the reference was verified against; add a smoke test that imports AbstractParser and asserts the .pxd attribute set; spec re-verifies against GitHub tag of the pinned version.

integration_risks.risk: Double slug lookup (toolkit tenant check + QS.build_provider) adds a DB round-trip per execution.
integration_risks.mitigation: Small TTL cache slug -> program_slug/is_multi in the toolkit; acceptable latency for LLM tool calls.

integration_risks.risk: Pipelines can embed inline SQL nodes ({"query": ..., "driver": ...}) that bypass slug tenancy.
integration_risks.mitigation: Reject inline query nodes when a programs allowlist is set unless allow_raw_sql=True.

claims.claim: QSourceTool is a single AbstractTool with a free-form `conditions` field and no tenant notion; DataNotFound is only imported under TYPE_CHECKING.
QS() accepts slug | query+driver | raw_query, merges stored conditions with caller conditions (caller wins) and returns (result, error) from query().
Tenancy is not enforced by querysource: get_slug ignores `program`, QueryModel.program_slug is a plain column.
claims.reasoning: Direct read of connections.py and models.py.

claims.claim: The conditions dialect is: option keys popped first; cond_definition keys become placeholders; other keys become WHERE filters with the grammar in F007; nested `conditions` merges.
claims.reasoning: Read from GitHub dev source, not the compiled 4.5.11 wheel; .pxd attribute set matches.

claims.claim: ComponentRegistry.get_catalog()/validate_pipeline() give the components catalog and pipeline validation in-process with the same shape as /api/v3/qs/components.
claims.reasoning: Direct read of registry.py and components.py.

claims.claim: A persisted multi-query is a queries row with pipeline JSON in query_raw; MultiQS detects it by queries/files/sources keys.
Deleting QSourceTool is a safe hard cut; only the auto-generated TOOL_REGISTRY references it.
claims.reasoning: Repo-wide grep excluding build/ artefacts; no commits in 90 days.

claims.claim: AbstractToolkit hooks (_prepare_kwargs/_pre_execute) are the right seam for tenant enforcement, following DatabaseQueryToolkit.
claims.reasoning: Direct read of toolkit.py docstrings describing these hooks for authorization.

claims.claim: @-variable functions (QS_VARIABLES) are supplied by the deploying app's settings, so the toolkit cannot enumerate them from the library alone.
claims.reasoning: services.py imports settings.settings.QUERYSOURCE_VARIABLES; whether the ai-parrot deployment defines any was not checked.

claims.claim: No tests exist for the current tool; QuerySlugSource tests show how QS is mocked.
claims.reasoning: Glob over packages/*/tests returned nothing for qsource/querytoolkit.

unknowns.question: How should the toolkit read the slug catalog (list/describe)?
plausible_answers: a) In-process via QueryModel/asyncdb using querysource's default_dsn (same path QS uses) — recommended
b) Via the QuerySource REST management API (/api/v1/management/queries) with a service token
unknowns.user_answer: a) In-process via QueryModel/asyncdb using querysource's default_dsn (same path QS uses)

unknowns.question: May the LLM persist multi-queries it composes (write to public.queries)?
plausible_answers: a) Yes, via an opt-in `allow_write=True` confirming tool that forces program_slug to the tenant (default off) — recommended
b) No — compose and run ad hoc only, never persist
c) Yes, but through the REST manager endpoint so PBAC applies
unknowns.user_answer: a) Yes, via an opt-in allow_write=True confirming tool that forces program_slug to the tenant (default off)

unknowns.question: When a programs allowlist is set, what about raw SQL (QS(query=...) and inline {"query": ...} pipeline nodes)?
plausible_answers: a) Forbidden whenever the toolkit is tenant-restricted (fail closed) — recommended
b) Allowed only with an explicit allow_raw_sql=True flag
c) Always allowed (tenancy applies to slugs only)
unknowns.user_answer: a) Forbidden whenever the toolkit is tenant-restricted (fail closed)

unknowns.question: Where does the tenant come from at runtime?
plausible_answers: a) Static constructor allowlist `programs=[...]` set in the agent config — recommended for v1
b) Derived per call from UserSession.tenant_id via _permission_context
c) Both: constructor allowlist intersected with the session tenant when present
unknowns.user_answer: a) Static constructor allowlist programs=[...] set in the agent config (None = unrestricted)

overall_confidence_rationale: Localization and the QS/MultiQS/registry contracts are read directly from the installed 4.5.11 package (high). The conditions dialect — a core deliverable — was reconstructed from GitHub dev sources because the wheel ships compiled parsers (medium). Product decisions on write access and tenant source remain open (U1–U4).

recommended_next_command.rationale: The architecture is settled (an AbstractToolkit mirroring DatabaseQueryToolkit, in-process querysource calls); remaining questions are product decisions resolvable in Q&A, not architectural forks. The spec must re-verify the dialect against the pinned querysource tag.
